Did you know over 3 million women in the U.S. suffer from endometriosis? The severe lack of research on this debilitating condition is another example of gender inequity in medical care. I joined @RepNikema, @repdavidscott, and @RepJenniffer in securing funding to change that.

For the last 12 years, the Affordable Care Act has helped lower costs, expand coverage, and deliver lifesaving protections. Thanks to this legislation, millions more Americans have access to coverage and are protected from being denied due to a pre-existing condition. #ThxACA

Proposed cuts to the Northport VA Medical Center would drastically affect how Long Island's 100,000+ veterans access health care. I joined @RepGarbarino and my other LI colleagues in a letter asking the VA to reconsider their recommendation.
